title: Live LinkedIn Profile Scraper | Miss Free
description: Send LinkedIn profile URLs. A hit returns the live full profile: experience with dates and descriptions, education, skills, certifications, and more. No match, no charge. This does not return email or phone.

urls.title: LinkedIn profile URLs
urls.description: Profile URLs that already open. Example: https://www.linkedin.com/in/example/
urls.sectionDescription: One URL, a list, a CSV, or a large file. A profile that is not found is free. A URL that no longer opens belongs in Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs first.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column. One profile URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV export from HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or an ATS. Column: url, linkedinUrl, or linkedin_url.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.sectionDescription: You pay only when a live profile comes back. A miss is free. Built for a single profile or a file of up to 1,000,000 URLs.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many profiles to fetch at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse the same ID after a stopped large run. Profiles already returned are skipped, so you are not charged again.

freshStart.title: Fetch finished profiles again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and fetch the whole list again.
